def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The full color-2 line is the guide; move the other colored object
    # toward it until adjacent, then draw a parallel 8-line behind the object.
    horizontal = next((r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 2 for v in row)), None)
    vertical = next((c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 2 for r in range(h))), None)
    if horizontal is not None:
        cells = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (2, 4)]
        if not cells: return out
        rows = [r for r, _, _ in cells]
        dr = 1 if horizontal > max(rows) else -1
        shift = (horizontal - (max(rows) if dr > 0 else min(rows))) - dr
        moved = [(r + shift, c, v) for r, c, v in cells]
        for r, c, _ in cells: out[r][c] = 4
        for r, c, v in moved: out[r][c] = v
        line_r = min(r for r, _, _ in moved) - 1 if dr > 0 else max(r for r, _, _ in moved) + 1
        if 0 <= line_r < h: out[line_r] = [8] * w
        return out
    if vertical is not None:
        cells = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (2, 4)]
        if not cells: return out
        cols = [c for _, c, _ in cells]
        dc = 1 if vertical > max(cols) else -1
        shift = (vertical - (max(cols) if dc > 0 else min(cols))) - dc
        moved = [(r, c + shift, v) for r, c, v in cells]
        for r, c, _ in cells: out[r][c] = 4
        for r, c, v in moved: out[r][c] = v
        line_c = min(c for _, c, _ in moved) - 1 if dc > 0 else max(c for _, c, _ in moved) + 1
        if 0 <= line_c < w:
            for r in range(h): out[r][line_c] = 8
        return out
    return out
PY
